description: `User.uri` is the MongoDB connection string CreateUser and ResetUser answer with, and it holds the user's password, but the spec types it as a plain string next to the `password` member convert already marks. STACKIT's Terraform provider marks its `uri` attribute `Sensitive` for the same reason (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/mongodbflex/user/resource.go, read 2026-11-01). Mark it sensitive.
